requirement: Produce FRAME evidence for every primary template in the batch
verification_method: Validator counts manifest rows by evidence_type against design-batch-plan.csv

requirement: Produce FOCUSED_FRAME evidence where a profile requires region-level rather than full-frame proof
verification_method: Validator checks profile minimum_evidence in responsive-state-mode-matrix.csv

requirement: Produce VARIANT evidence for every contracted state and option variant
verification_method: Validator checks state coverage per profile

requirement: Produce ANNOTATION evidence for interaction focus order semantics and accessibility notes
verification_method: Validator requires an annotation row per template

requirement: Produce PROTOTYPE evidence for focus return disclosure modal and transition behaviour
verification_method: Validator requires a prototype row where the template declares interaction

requirement: Produce ROUTE_INSTANCE_SHEET evidence for every route instance assigned to the batch
verification_method: Validator reconciles against foundation-route-coverage.csv

requirement: Do not produce TEST_CAPTURE evidence under MA-025
verification_method: Validator fails if evidence_type TEST_CAPTURE appears in any manifest

requirement: Every public evidence_id conforms to HSD_UIR_<BATCH>_<TEMPLATE>_<INSTANCE>_<STATE>_<VIEWPORT>_<MODE>_<STREAM>_V<NN>, where <STREAM> is STREAM_HIGH, STREAM_MEDIUM, STREAM_LOW or STREAM_SEMANTIC. <STREAM> is mandatory on every evidence ID; there is no omissible form and no aggregate form. A public frame shows one stream. Excluded staff templates instead require SCOPE_EXCLUDED at that position and stream_id=STREAM-SCOPE-EXCLUDED; this is a nonpublic scope marker, never a fifth stream
verification_method: Validator parses the grammar and resolves every segment including <STREAM> (A-12)

requirement: Revisions increment V<NN> only within the lineage tuple (BATCH, TEMPLATE, INSTANCE, STATE, VIEWPORT, MODE, STREAM), without renaming stable template or instance source IDs
verification_method: Validator compares the seven-part lineage tuple across revisions

requirement: Cover VP-320 VP-NARROW VP-LANDSCAPE VP-TABLET VP-DESKTOP VP-WIDE and VP-ZOOM-400 where the profile requires it
verification_method: Validator checks viewport_id against the profile required_values

requirement: Cover every accessibility degraded and input mode required by the assigned profile
verification_method: Validator checks mode_id against the profile required_values

requirement: Annotate the batch declared WCAG 2.2 SC 2.2.1 branch visibly in evidence
verification_method: Validator checks time_limit_branch matches design-batch-plan.csv

requirement: TL-WARN-EXTEND evidence must show a warning at least 20 seconds before expiry and an extension of at least 10 times the default
verification_method: Independent accessibility review plus validator annotation presence check

requirement: TL-REMOVABLE-ADJUSTABLE evidence must show the off or adjust-before-start control
verification_method: Not exercised under MA-025

requirement: No record may select TL-EXCEPTION
verification_method: Validator fails on any TL-EXCEPTION value

requirement: Every component used maps to a PRIM-* identifier from component-primitives.csv
verification_method: Validator resolves every manifest prim_ids value against the accepted primitive set

requirement: Every frame copy is a reference fixture visibly marked REFERENCE FIXTURE — NOT PUBLIC COPY
verification_method: Validator requires the marker in the annotation export and the independent design review confirms visibility

requirement: No gated fact may be invented to fill a frame
verification_method: Stop condition SC-01 plus independent design review

requirement: Only D-035 brand-identity assets and semantic tokens are used
verification_method: Validator resolves asset references against docs/phase-1-brand-identity/asset-manifest.json

requirement: PNG exports at fixed 2x scale and SVG at 1x with fixed background and no ad-hoc cropping
verification_method: Validator checks export_scale uniformity per evidence_type

requirement: Every exported file is hashed uppercase SHA-256 and recorded in the batch manifest
verification_method: Validator recomputes each file hash and compares

requirement: The batch manifest is hashed with the D-037 freeze algorithm ordinal-sorted forward-slash paths uppercase hash two spaces path LF joined no terminal newline UTF-8 without BOM
verification_method: Validator recomputes the manifest freeze hash

requirement: Exports are regenerated never hand-edited
verification_method: Hash mismatch against a fresh export voids the artifact

requirement: Editor chrome screenshots are not evidence
verification_method: Independent design review rejects chrome screenshots

requirement: Record the file key and the page and frame inventory without credentials
verification_method: Validator credential scan plus presence of inventory JSON

requirement: No credential-shaped string appears in any export filename manifest field inventory JSON or annotation
verification_method: Validator credential-pattern scan over the evidence tree

requirement: No export may be captioned or described as a rendered product a live page a test result an accessibility audit a conformance statement or approved public content
verification_method: Validator unsupported-claim scan plus both independent reviews

requirement: Create a named _PRE version and export its archive before the first write of a batch
verification_method: Validator requires the _PRE archive and its hash in the manifest

requirement: Create a named _EXIT version and export its archive at batch exit
verification_method: Validator requires the _EXIT archive and its hash in the manifest

requirement: Accepted batch evidence is never overwritten in place. Append-only identity is the FULL evidence_id including <STREAM>, so one template captured in S-HIGH and in S-SEMANTIC is two artifacts rather than an illegal overwrite
verification_method: Evidence directories are append-only; corrections create a new V<NN> within the same lineage tuple

requirement: Every (template, stream-critical coordinate, stream) triple obliged by the batch has a resolving manifest row, or a stream_disposition entry naming the batch that produces it. Producing a batch in one stream does not discharge it
verification_method: Validator resolves obliged triples against manifest rows by stream_id (A-14)

requirement: Exactly one stream per manifest row. stream_id is mandatory, single-valued, and drawn from S-HIGH, S-MEDIUM, S-LOW, S-SEMANTIC. Empty is illegal and multi-valued is illegal, and stream_id must agree with the <STREAM> segment of the row evidence_id
verification_method: Validator checks presence, cardinality, vocabulary and agreement (A-12, A-15)

requirement: A stream a batch does not produce is recorded in stream_disposition as deferred_<BATCH_ID> naming the batch that does produce it, or as not_present validated against the computed union of template presence. Silence is inexpressible, mirroring EC-14
verification_method: Validator resolves every disposition key and value (A-13)
